newsitem.title: UK: Brazil, Thailand feature in sugar freight business.
newsitem.headline: Brazil, Thailand feature in sugar freight business.

text.p: South Brazilian ports again featured prominently on the London sugar freight market on Wednesday and some business was also noted from the tail-end of Thailand's shipment cycle, shipbrokers said.
Vitol fixed 25/28,000 tonnes in bulk from Santos to Morocco with options of Black Sea and Baltic for mid-June and Louis Dreyfus fixed 12/14,000 tonnes from Thailand to Pakistan, they said.
E D & F Man fixed 20/25,000 tonnes from Paranagua to Baltic/Black Sea for June 20/25 and a further 12,500 tonnes in bags from Immingham to Tunisia for mid-June.
Of the new orders, Cargill quoted for 14,000 tonnes from Santos to Black Sea with Med/Baltic options for mid-June.
It was also open for 14,000 tonnes in bags from Coatzacoalcos to Baltic/Med/Red Sea and various Indian subcontinent options.
Brazilian shippers SIMAB quoted for 10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Itajai to Lagos for June 10/15.
